summary: Expanded the universe around AI data-center power/cooling balance-of-plant with a two-lane list: one reference/near-reference name for liquid cooling and power distribution context, plus three underfollowed or shadow candidates where the exposure may be hidden in HVAC, thermal management, electrical infrastructure, or custom power-distribution labels. The strongest direct evidence in this pass is liquid-cooling order/backlog/capacity disclosure at AAON/BASX, Modine/Airedale, and nVent. Methode is included as a speculative small-cap exception because its public materials and reporting point to cloud/data-center power distribution exposure, but the AI-rack chokepoint linkage needs verification.
